matching.same_initialization: Copy identical-shape tensors from one shared initial legacy model; only the factorized node-kind parameters are newly initialized.
matching.same_grammar_candidates: Teacher-prefix terminalizable masks and free-running root/child masks; completion-budget candidate pruning is disabled in both arms.
matching.budget_floor: Both batches carry per-language TreeCompletionBudget.minimum_root_nodes(); only the candidate interprets logits as residuals above that floor.
matching.decoder: Greedy; one completion per each of the 64 frozen validation fragments; no retries or selection.

metrics: teacher-forced per-head accuracy and node-kind supported-class macro-F1
node-kind legal candidate-set size, masked accuracy, and invalid-target count
per-case generation latency and first failure
evaluation.execution: The frozen AST validation pack provides prompts and typed target actions but no expected runtime inputs/results; do not execute arbitrary corpus code. Executable outcomes remain the separate NLP-077 synthetic task track.
evaluation.promotion: Diagnostic only. A positive result requires a fresh source-disjoint matched confirmation; it does not reopen the strict 60-case gate.

evidence_boundary: One-seed matched structured-head screen; validation only, no executable or capability claim, no test content.
